SELECT 
  s.supplier_id,
  s.sup_name,
  s.sup_mail,
  sp.product_id,
  sp.supplier_product_code,
  sp.price_per_unit,
  ri.NAME,
  ri.UNIT,
  ri.PRODUCT_ID AS rest_product_id,
  po.ordered_quantity,
  po.ordered_unit,
  po.order_id
FROM suppliers s
JOIN pending_orders po ON po.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
JOIN rest_inventory ri ON po.product_id = ri.PRODUCT_ID
JOIN supplier_products sp ON sp.product_id = po.product_id 
  AND sp.supplier_id = po.supplier_id
WHERE po.gmail_thread_id = '{{ $json.threadId }}'
  AND po.status = 'pending'
  AND s.sup_mail = '{{ $json.from.value[0].address }}'

INSERT INTO batch 
  (batch_number, product_id, initial_quantity, quantity, expiry_date, unit_cost, supplier_id)
VALUES 
  ('{{ $json.batch_number }}', {{ $json.product_id }}, {{ $json.confirmed_quantity }}, {{ $json.confirmed_quantity }}, '{{ $json.expiry_date }}', {{ $json.unit_cost }}, {{ $json.supplier_id }});

UPDATE pending_orders
SET status = 'confirmed'
WHERE order_id = {{ $json.order_id }};

UPDATE rest_inventory ri
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS tot_qty,
         SUM(quantity * unit_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(quantity), 0) AS wac
  FROM batch GROUP BY product_id
) agg ON ri.PRODUCT_ID = agg.product_id
SET ri.QUANTITY = COALESCE(agg.tot_qty, 0),
    ri.UNIT_COST = COALESCE(agg.wac, ri.UNIT_COST);

SELECT 
  s.supplier_id,
  s.sup_name,
  s.sup_mail,
  sp.supplier_product_code,
  sp.price_per_unit,
  ri.NAME,
  ri.PRODUCT_ID,
  ri.UNIT,
  po.ordered_quantity,
  po.ordered_unit,
  po.order_id
FROM supplier_products sp
JOIN suppliers s ON sp.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
JOIN rest_inventory ri ON sp.product_id = ri.PRODUCT_ID
JOIN pending_orders po ON po.product_id = ri.PRODUCT_ID AND po.status = 'pending'
WHERE sp.product_id = (
  SELECT product_id FROM supplier_products 
  WHERE supplier_product_code = '{{ $json.supplier_product_code }}'
  LIMIT 1
)
AND sp.is_preferred = 0;
